hero.headline: A website template that turns Claude Code into your web developer
hero.subheadline: Create a repo, type /onboard, answer a few questions — done. No coding required.

howItWorks.title: Three steps to your site
howItWorks.subtitle: From empty terminal to a finished, bilingual marketing site.

step1.title: Create the project
step1.description: One line in your terminal: `pnpm create passionfruit my-site`. Or run `/create-passionfruit-site` from inside Claude Code. Either way: template downloaded, git initialized, dependencies installed.

step2.title: Open Claude and run /onboard
step2.description: Eight questions — company name, languages, colors, pages, contact details. Claude personalizes the template, rewrites i18n, branding, and content.

step3.title: Go live with /deploy
step3.description: Claude sets up Cloudflare Pages, points your domain, and wires preview deploys for every PR. Every push to main publishes.
